metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed picture heights to 20, 30, 25cm on slides 3, 4, 6 using the Position and Size panel in LibreOffice Impress. All three edits confirmed in status bar.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slide panel, click images, use Properties panel to set height values, apply changes with Enter
metadata.explanation: Exact replication of the source trajectory goal. Getter finds the FREEFORM shape on slide 3, PICTURE on slide 4, and largest PICTURE on slide 6, returning their heights in cm. Metric checks all three with 0.5cm tolerance for UI rounding. Initial state (26.78, 28.57, 26.03cm) fails the check. [Fixed: renamed getter to get_picture_heights__eff65ebb8ed6d102db81f31da1a823ed with proper 32-char MD5 suffix; inlined emu_to_cm helper to avoid nested-def validation error; renamed metric to check_picture_heights__eff65ebb8ed6d102db81f31da1a823ed; inlined close_enough helper; updated evaluator.func and result.type accordingly]

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves 30_1.pptx from the Docker environment and parses it with python-pptx.
Slide 3: targets FREEFORM shape (type 5), consistent with trajectory evidence that the image is stored as a Google Shape/FREEFORM.
Slide 4: targets PICTURE shape (type 13) with height > 5cm filter, correctly identifies the main image.
Slide 6: targets PICTURE shape (type 13) with largest width, reasonable heuristic for identifying the dominant image.
Metric checks all three required heights with 0.5cm tolerance and awards partial credit (1/3 per slide).
Negative control resistance confirmed: initial heights (26.78, 28.57, 26.03cm) differ significantly from targets (20, 30, 25cm) and will fail.
Rule validation issues are stale (pre-fix); actual function files on disk have correct MD5-suffixed names matching evaluator.func and result.type.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Slide 6 selects by largest width rather than height; consider selecting by largest height or by explicit shape name to be more robust if multiple pictures exist.
Slide 3 uses FREEFORM (type 5) instead of PICTURE (type 13); add a fallback to also check PICTURE shapes in case the file format changes on re-save.
